setting: You are all dog walkers who meet at a park in Tallinn, Estonia, and you know each other from walking your dogs there. Each of you lives in Tallinn. Right now you are sorting out who covers which walks on wet days and swapping the times you collect dogs from the park gate, and this group chat is where you do it.

text: [photo: dog in puddle]
He went straight in. This is tomorrow's walk btw
Oh no. Rain all day tomorrow?
Yes. 10 to 16 maybe
I can take the 10 o'clock gate pickup if Markus does the afternoon
Morning. Gate at 10 still?
Can do afternoon. 3?
3 is fine. I'll take 1 if nobody else wants it
Gate at 10 for me yes. Bring the big towel
Rain is coming in sideways now
Ok. The afternoon one, is the gate still by the fountain or did they move it
Still fountain side. Other gate locked since the work
Ok
Can't do 3 actually, client wants a cut by 5. Can someone swap
I can do 3 but I'm at the vet with Rex until maybe 2:30
Ok I'll do 3 then. So 1 is open? Who has 1
Vet till 2:30 so not me. Sorry
I'll take the 1 if I can leave the cut at 12. Probably ok
Mari you're on 3 yes?
Yes
Did the 10 walk. Soaked. Brown dog is never dry
[photo: brown dog on the bench, wet]
Lol he looks personally offended
Home. Puddle dog is in the bath being sad about it
[photo: dog in bathtub with a face]
Ha
Forecast for Monday says dry. Anybody want to swap the 7th with me for the 14th? I have the dentist
Or nevermind I'll sort it at the gate
